storyCards.headline: Escape: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Enrique Iglesias's "Escape" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Escape" is a song written by Enrique Iglesias, Steve Morales, Kara DioGuardi, and David Siegel for Iglesias's fifth studio album, Escape (2001).

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Escape was released in 2001.
